request.style: English, warm female solo voice, gentle acoustic guitar, soft piano, light harp, mellow cello, peaceful and steady mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
After Abimelech's time was done
Tola son of Puah rose up
Son of Dodo in the sun
A man of Issachar he was

[Verse]
He lived in Shamir it is true
In the hill country of Ephraim
He brought the peace back to the view
And saved the people from their whim

[Chorus]
He judged Israel for twenty-three
Years of quiet and stability
He served the land with gentle care
A judge who lived without a scare

[Verse]
His lineage from Dodo came
From the tribe that knew his name
He exercised his office well
In the hill where the shadows fell

[Chorus]
He judged Israel for twenty-three
Years of quiet and stability
He served the land with gentle care
A judge who lived without a scare

[Outro]
Then he died and found his rest
Buried in Shamir where he blessed
